CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   C. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)

   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
